----
 
<br> <br>
Dekey checks the '''integrity''' of .bisign, .bikey, and .biprivatekey 
files.

 
It does not crack them open as such, merely checks their 
validity.

 
Dekey is most useful in doing a full folder scan looking 
for version ONE bisigns versus the shinier version 2's. A bonus for sysops

 
Syntax:<br> <br>
dekey [-P] whatever'''.bisign''' | '''bikey |''' '''privatekey'''

 
-P don't pause

 
Return status

 
0: no errors (includes version2 bisigns)

 
1: version 1 (old) bisign

 
2: error

 
<br>
